changes: First release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74: CHROMATIC pads send their aftertouch on the note they played.
Stock sent the poly pressure 24 semitones above the note on, so a synth following the held note saw no aftertouch.
The pressure stays on the held note when UP or DOWN shift the pads, and stops at the note off.
Nothing else changes, and there is nothing to set.
